<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// Update post titles to include their actual IDs
$posts = get_posts(array(
	'post_type' => 'post',
	'posts_per_page' => -1,
	'post_status' => 'publish',
	'orderby' => 'ID',
	'order' => 'ASC'
));

foreach ($posts as $post) {
	if (strpos($post->post_title, 'will be updated') !== false) {
		wp_update_post(array(
			'ID' => $post->ID,
			'post_title' => 'Test Post - ID: ' . $post->ID
		));
	}
}

echo 'Cleaned and created ' . count($posts) . ' test posts';
?>
